name: Ahrefs
summary: SEO tools for backlinks and keywords.

flows.title: Add a project to your dashboard
steps: Go to the Dashboard and click + Create.
There are two ways to add a project: import it from Google Search Console, or add it manually. Choose Add manually.
Step 1 sets the project scope. Specify your domain or URL, then select the protocol and mode suited to your needs.
The Project name is pre-filled from the URL's title tag; amend it as you see fit, then click Continue.

Step 2 verifies ownership. To skip verifying your project's ownership, click Continue. You can add an unlimited number of verified projects, while unverified projects are limited based on your subscription plan.
Step 3 is the Site Audit schedule, URL sources and crawl settings: you may run scheduled crawls with a predefined frequency, and set the seed URLs that Site Audit will start crawling from.
Step 4 is Rank Tracking. Input the keywords and select the location or locations you want to track positions in Google for, then click Continue.

Step 5 adds the competitors you want to track for the project against the keywords entered in step 4. Those competitors and keywords go into the Rank Tracker tool, and the Dashboard project is then created.

flows.title: Edit a project's Site Audit settings
steps: From the Dashboard or the Site Audit dashboard, pick the project whose Site Audit settings you want to edit, and click the 3 dot menu at the right most of the project.
Click Site Audit to open the Site Audit settings.
The other way in is from within a Site Audit crawl itself: click the settings cogwheel icon in the top right-hand corner, click Project settings, then click Site Audit.
Any changes to project settings you save only apply to new Site Audit crawls. Already completed Site Audit crawls are not affected.
